# CheckATS

> CheckATS is a free, independent ATS resume preparation tool at https://checkats.online/. Compare pasted resume text or a text-based PDF with a job description, then request optional AI feedback or a rewrite. No account required.

## Main pages

- [Resume checker](https://checkats.online/): local keyword matching and extracted-text checks.
- [Scoring method and data handling](https://checkats.online/methodology/): current formula, rules, limits, worked example, and external processing.
- [Resume guides](https://checkats.online/guide/): published resume resources.
- [Software engineer checklist](https://checkats.online/guide/ats-resume-checklist-software-engineers/): practical advice with product limitations and a vendor source.
- [PDF Resume Studio](https://checkats.online/studio/): 30 templates, local Typst rendering, no watermark, native-text PDF output.
- [Account and plans](https://checkats.online/account/?tab=plans): points balance, saved jobs (up to 20), check-in, and purchase options.
- [CheckATS vs Jobscan](https://checkats.online/guide/checkats-vs-jobscan/): free ATS checker comparison.
- [CheckATS vs Resume Worded](https://checkats.online/guide/checkats-vs-resume-worded/): which free ATS check shows its work.
- [CheckATS vs Teal](https://checkats.online/guide/checkats-vs-teal/): no-signup ATS check vs all-in-one tracker.
- [Free Jobscan alternative](https://checkats.online/guide/free-jobscan-alternative/): ATS resume check with no signup.

## Facts and limits

- The simulated score is 60% selected JD exact-keyword coverage plus 40% extracted-text checks; it is not an employer ATS score or a hiring probability.
- A skills dictionary selects JD terms; statistical extraction supplements thin matches or acts as a fallback. Matching ignores case but does not expand synonyms or acronyms.
- The four text checks test email presence, supported date formats, clean characters, and 300–3,000 non-whitespace characters. They do not inspect the original document layout or recognize every valid date format.
- Text-based PDF import runs locally; scanned PDFs need OCR, which is not included. DOCX upload is not supported.
- Optional AI review assesses writing, results, specificity, and role alignment separately from the local score. Review uses Qwen through SiliconFlow first, with Cloudflare Workers AI as fallback; rewrite uses DeepSeek. AI outputs may vary and can be inaccurate.
- Logged-in users spend points: 10 per AI review, 20 per AI rewrite (includes one free review of the rewritten resume). Email verification earns 50 permanent points; daily check-in earns 10. Anonymous visitors are limited by IP: 5 review requests and 2 rewrite requests per UTC day. Automatic review refreshes also consume requests; shared networks share allowances.
- Local checks do not upload the resume. Optional AI review and rewrite send it to external providers; email delivery uses Resend. See the methodology page for data handling.
- CheckATS is not affiliated with Greenhouse, Workday, or other ATS vendors. Their features and employer configurations differ.

## Pricing
- Pack: one-time USD 9.90 for 800 permanent points.
- Pass: USD 19.90 per billing period for 2,000 points per period.
- PDF export requires a paid purchase (premium).
- Payments are processed by Creem; checkout is currently in test mode.

## PDF Studio
- 30 templates across single- and two-column layouts, adapted from davidculemann/typst-templates (MIT-0).
- Rendering is local via Typst; photos are not sent to AI.
- Drafts use browser session storage; no template guarantees compatibility with every employer's parser.
